readerCopy.body: A larger opportunity can become a distraction when expansion replaces the smaller decision that would actually change direction. When Jupiter squares the North Node, growth and forward movement create friction, making another project, credential, trip, or ambitious plan look like progress while the unresolved choice underneath it keeps returning. More options do not solve indecision when every option preserves the same arrangement. The next step becomes clearer when expansion follows the decision instead of standing in for it.
